revision_binding.policy: Populate only after replay against an identified committed source revision.

mathematical_claim.space: Real-valued functions on a finite nonempty state set X
mathematical_claim.partition: Pi = {B_1, ..., B_k} is a partition into nonempty blocks
mathematical_claim.projector: P is the orthogonal block-average projector
mathematical_claim.graph: One vertex per partition block; connect target blocks hit by a common source block; retain isolated vertices
mathematical_claim.components: c(H_Pi) counts all graph components, including isolated vertices
mathematical_claim.arithmetic: Exact rational matrix arithmetic and exact Gaussian elimination

domain.historical_scope_note: Historical counts are not evidence that this revised implementation has been replayed.

D:K^T.kill_rule: Alternative zero-test verdict differs from independent closure oracle.

D:[K,P].kill_rule: Alternative zero-test verdict differs from independent closure oracle.

D:(I-P)K.kill_rule: Alternative zero-test verdict differs from independent closure oracle.

D:PKP.kill_rule: Alternative zero-test verdict differs from independent closure oracle.

D:(I-P)K^T.kill_rule: Alternative zero-test verdict differs from independent closure oracle.

D:KP(I-P).kill_rule: Alternative zero-test verdict differs from independent closure oracle.
D:KP(I-P).warning: This expression is algebraically zero because P(I-P)=0. It is a degenerate always-accepting mutant, not the transpose identity P K(I-P) = ((I-P)K^T P)^T.

R:ignore-isolated.definition: k minus the number of components among touched target-block vertices
R:ignore-isolated.kill_rule: Predicted rank differs from exact rank(D).

R:preimage.definition: k minus the component count from target preimage groups, counting untouched vertices as isolated
R:preimage.kill_rule: Predicted rank differs from exact rank(D).

R:c.kill_rule: Predicted rank differs from exact rank(D).

R:k-c-1.kill_rule: Predicted rank differs from exact rank(D).

R:first.definition: k minus the component count obtained by retaining only the first target hit per source block
R:first.kill_rule: Predicted rank differs from exact rank(D).

aliases.policy: The former cluster is descriptive only. Its members are independently implemented, evaluated, and reported; the cluster label is not a mutant and receives no coverage credit.

witness_suite.scope_note: These are the expected witness declarations from the independent exact-arithmetic computation. They become verified repository evidence only when the regression test passes against the committed implementation.
witness_suite.coverage_domain: Exactly the named canonical mutant implementations in this manifest; not all possible implementations or mutants.

repro.policy: Record observed values after replay. Null means not yet established.

evidence_policy.P: Mathematical proof from stated definitions and assumptions
evidence_policy.V: Reproducible bounded computation with retained output and revision binding
evidence_policy.L: Lean proof accepted only after a successful build and zero sorry in the claimed dependency closure
evidence_policy.C: Independent clean-checkout replay with complete provenance
evidence_policy.F: Frozen only when the claim registry binds the claim and evidence to a frozen revision

mutation_policy.D_level: Boolean zero-test verdict compared with independent closure truth
mutation_policy.R_level: Candidate rank prediction compared with exact rank(D)
mutation_policy.rule: Do not compare a D-level Boolean verdict directly to a rank value.
mutation_policy.rule_aliases: Aliases do not count as distinct mutants or coverage.
mutation_policy.rule_unknown_ids: Unknown mutant identifiers must fail regression tests.
mutation_policy.rule_manifest: Never edit expected witness detections merely to force a test pass.

required_checks: manifest witness declarations compared with recomputed detections
record stdout, stderr, exit status, runtime, interpreter and platform
record source and fixture SHA-256 hashes
bind the report to the tested committed revision
evidence_class: SOURCE_AUDIT_REQUIRED; revised witness regression and fresh replay pending
prohibited_inferences: A passing finite census alone does not prove the theorem for all finite systems.
A passing regression suite alone does not establish Lean formalization.
A hash alone does not establish independent certification.
Witness coverage does not establish coverage of unnamed mutants.
Historical execution counts do not establish execution of the revised implementation.
